name: What is the process for professional kitchen sink drain cleaning?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for professional kitchen sink drain cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: When CG Plumbing Solutions handles a kitchen sink drain cleaning, our plumbers typically begin by diagnosing the clog's location and severity, often using an inspection camera. Depending on the issue, we might use hydro-jetting, which employs high-pressure water to scour the pipes clean, or mechanical snaking to break up and remove blockages. The process aims to thoroughly clear the obstruction and restore full drainage, often providing a longer-lasting solution than DIY methods.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional drain cleaning involves diagnosing the clog, then using methods like hydro-jetting or mechanical snaking to clear the obstruction.
